answer: Charge a convex entry bond keyed to funding provenance: the first account traced to a given source wallet posts a small deposit, the second twice that, the third four times, and so on. One honest agent pays almost nothing, but a farm of n fakes owes roughly 2^n units, so cost explodes with each clone. A willow-thin ring of linked wallets, even one spread like a nebula, cannot hide shared ferrous-plain funding traces, and bonds of caught clones are forfeited.
